# TaskFlow

TaskFlow is a task management web application that helps users organize, filter, and track their daily tasks with priorities and due dates.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Overview of total, completed, in-progress, and pending tasks
- [My Tasks](/): Full task list with filtering by All, Today, Upcoming, and Completed
- [Calendar](/): Calendar view of tasks by due date
- [Important](/): High-priority tasks
- [Settings](/): User preferences and account settings

## Notes

This is a client-side single-page application built with React and Tailwind CSS.
